anchor.meaning: Enemy body centre. Draw each frame with this pixel on the enemy position (e.x, e.y).

scaleRule: drawScale = LST.StatusLook.bodyR(e) / refBodyR (world units per sheet px); i.e. draw the frame at frame.w * bodyR/88 world units wide. Same art for every enemy type, no tint.

provenance.postProcess: _tools/process_v011.py build_disc (key bg + gray placeholder circle, un-mix, split row at gaps, register circle centre on anchor, scale x1.0179 (circle->2*refBodyR would be x1.2055; reduced to fit the 288 cell), strip)
